messages:
Sam: Quick sync — I'm updating the /v1/generate contract to accept new routing params. Pls confirm backward-compat approach.
Maya: which param name? `model_hint` or `model_select`?
Sam: We'll add `model_select` (array of model IDs) and keep `model` (string) for backwards compatibility. Server should prefer `model_select` if present.
Ben: prefer `model_select`. Also do we need an explicit `fallback_order` field or just rely on the array order?
Irene: rely on array order is fine, but doc it. Fallback rules must be deterministic and tested.
Sam: Proposed rules:
- if `model_select` present -> try entries in order
- if only `model` present -> treat as single-entry list
- if none -> use service default model
- if candidate model incompatible -> try next compatible variant in list
Maya: define "incompatible"? schema mismatch, tokenizer differences, or architecture?
Ben: for runtime: incompatible = incompatible tokenizer or model architecture that can't load weights/kv cache. If incompatible at init -> skip and try next.
Sam: For single `model` (legacy) we should return 409 + structured error with `suggested_alternatives` rather than silently falling back. For `model_select` we auto-fallback.
Irene: Also need region/tier hints: headers `x-region-hint` and `x-tier-hint`. Routing should prefer same region & tier; if not available and `allow_cross_region=true` then fall back across regions. Document precedence.
Sam: Example response when a fallback was served (include fields for observability):
```json
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "served_model": "redwood-v1-8k-quant",
  "request_model": "mosaic-2-lli",
  "note": "served fallback due to tokenizer mismatch",
  "choices": [{"text": "..."}]
}
```
Maya: should we include `fallback_chain` array for debugging? e.g. `["mosaic-2-lli","redwood-v1-8k-quant"]`
Ben: yes include `fallback_chain` but only in debug mode or when `include_routing_info=true` to avoid leaking internal catalogs.
Irene: I'll add unit tests for `model_select` ordering, incompatibility detection, and region hint precedence.
Sam: Also add an API contract lint that flags changed response keys. PR #4326 touching the contract linting.
Ben: pinged @Maya @Irene on the PR for a quick review.
deploy-bot: routing-lint CI job started for PR 4331 :gear:
Irene: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4331 — tests updated, coverage note added.
Sam: Thanks — plan to merge tomorrow morning if no objections. @Maya please add a short entry to the API changelog and note the fallback behavior. :thumbsup:
Maya: will do, quick doc patch incoming.
Ben: LGTM from me, leaving final to Irene for tests.
Irene: will review and approve if tests are green.
